title: 21. Projects: Social Media Feed System (capstone design)
summary: Design and build core components of a social media platform like Twitter/Instagram.
objectives: Build the Social Media Feed System (capstone design) projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body:
Design and build core components of a social media platform like Twitter/Instagram.

**You will build:**

1. Post/Tweet Service with timeline generation
2. News Feed (Fan-out on Write vs Read)
3. Follow/Unfollow with social graph
4. Trending Topics detection
5. PySpark engagement analytics
